title: In Canada’s Arctic, a New Generation of Inuit Creatives Are Using Identity to Fuel Their Art
summary: In Iqaluit, the only city in Canada’s Arctic, a new generation of Inuit writers and artists is turning questions of language, land and identity into books, films and even tattoos.
